apolar.content:
# A constant splitting and a sextic-net apolar obstruction exclude O(-8)+O(2)+O(16)

## 1. Statement and exact scope

Work over C on the fixed physical binary-icosahedral parameter line, with G=SL2(F5), defining representation W, and the original actual saturated plane-section inclusion

    0 -> E -> H O -> Q -> 0,   dim H=30,
    S=Q* inside H* O,
    K=E^-, L=S^-, A=E/K, B=S/L.

Superscript minus means the actual kernel of the second fundamental form for the constant connection. Suppose that the actual Gauss rank is three and its maximal rank-three plateau has profile (1,1). In particular rank E=17, rank S=13, both degrees are -54, top S<=-1, rank L=10, and the derivative of L has rank at most two.

We prove that

    A=O(-8)+O(2)+O(16)                                (1)

is impossible. The original necessary profile-(1,1) theorem and its complete 159-pair list give exactly two ordered records with this A:

    original index 119: B=O(6)+O(-16)+O(-18), defect 12;
    original index 127: B=O(6)+O(-4)+O(-18), defect 0.    (2)

We exclude the first directly by endpoint degree capacity. For the second, equality has two possible endpoint heights. Height 8 is excluded by the full degree-ten polynomial system and its apolar annihilator. Height 7 gives a genuine constant splitting of the actual inclusion, reducing to a rank 16 bundle in a constant 21-space. A partial degree-ten polynomial system is allowed in this residual argument; a basepoint-free sextic-net lemma forces it to be full before the final ambient-dimension contradiction.

This is a narrow A-shape exclusion within maximal profile(1,1), not a full profile-(1,1) exclusion or global rank-three theorem. The two row labels are historical identifiers, not a live-frontier count. The geometric necessity of the original list is an imported written theorem, not inferred from JSON. No selected actual HM/source coefficients, points, parameters, jets, matrices, tensors, instance ranks, scans or large computation are evaluated.

Seven complete immutable inputs are retained in inputs/ and pinned by full URL, byte count, SHA256 and Git blob ID in INPUTS.json. The original actual inclusion, strict-top theorem, profile11 theorem/list and physical character source are at db51525015bb7c5e825833d550d08dedf6f6ea96. The primary four-source theorem is PR1123 at 504b7eb800407dfc7e6340c98c72cdd553939f54. Each retained file was freshly read at its immutable public URL and compared byte-for-byte. No later ledger or unproved profile coverage is used.

The primary theorem leaves four actual E types. Only its D-type has any summand of degree at most -8; the other three admit no nonzero map to O(-8). The onto composite E->A->O(-8) therefore forces

    E=D O(-2)+(W'+T)O(-3)+V O(-4)+O(-8),              (3)

where D=Sym4 W, T=Sym5 W, dim W'=2, dim V=3, and V is the nonstandard three-dimensional representation, distinct from A_std=Sym2 W. We use the universal identities

    Sym6 W=V+P,  Sym7 W=W'+T,
    Sym8 W=P+D,  Sym10 W=A_std+V+D,                  (4)

with dim P=4. All irreducibles are self-dual, and G has no nontrivial one-dimensional representations. Thus every equivariant line occurring below has the stated O(e) linearization, with no additional character twist. The fixed determinant identification identifies the parameter line with P(W); the same choice is used throughout.

## 2. Actual endpoint capacity and its equality case

Let F_0=S, F_1=L and F_(j+1)=F_j^- thereafter. These are saturated subbundles of the original constant H* O. Put G_j=F_j/F_(j+1), q_j=rank G_j for j>=1 and G_0=B. The actual derivative induces sheaf injections

    G_j -> G_(j-1)(-2) -> ... -> B(-2j).              (5)

To justify the first injection, differentiation of F_j stays in F_(j-1), and the kernel of its projection modulo F_j is exactly F_(j+1). This is an actual coherent-image statement, not an assertion that the image is saturated in the target. It also gives q_(j+1)<=q_j. Since L is the endpoint, q_1<=2.

Every F_j is negative, as a subbundle of S. A nonzero such bundle cannot be horizontal: its Grassmannian map would have zero differential, hence be constant in characteristic zero, making the saturated subbundle constant of degree zero. Thus the chain terminates in zero and

    sum q_j=10,   deg L=sum deg G_j.

Let lambda_1>=lambda_2>=lambda_3 be the ordinary degrees of B. Taking determinants in (5) gives

    deg G_j <= sum_(i=1)^q_j lambda_i -2j q_j.

With h_i=#{j:q_j>=i}, one has h_1>=h_2>=0, h_1+h_2=10, and

    deg L <= h_1 lambda_1-h_1(h_1+1)
             +h_2 lambda_2-h_2(h_2+1).               (6)

There are just six universal rank partitions, h_1=5,...,10. For index 119 their capacities, in that order, are

    -110, -90, -74, -62, -54, -50.

But deg L=-54-(-28)=-26, exceeding even the maximum -50. This excludes the positive-defect record without any zero-defect argument.

For index 127 the six capacities are

    -50, -42, -38, -38, -42, -50,

and deg L=-54-(-16)=-38. Therefore equality holds in every individual determinant bound, and the height pair is (7,3) or (8,2).

Here the three degrees 6,-4,-18 are distinct. The highest-degree summand in wedge^q B is unique for q=1,2. Equality makes the determinant map a nonzero constant into that summand; all lower components vanish by degree. The generic image is consequently the top q-summand subspace. The map factors through that top subbundle everywhere, because the projected map vanishes generically and its target is torsion-free. Its determinant has no zero, so

    G_j -> B(-2j) identifies G_j with B_(q_j)(-2j),    (7)

where B_q is the top q-summand subbundle. These are exact images of actual composite derivative maps. In particular the highest-line channel of each intermediate derivative is nonzero: composing it with the preceding identification gives the nonzero highest-line channel in (7). It is an isomorphism on that line after the indicated twist.

Writing h=h_1, the last nonzero F_h is the saturated line

    C=O(6-2h).                                       (8)

Its first k derivatives, for 0<=k<=h, have a new nonzero leading component in the successive graded terms and are generically independent. Their span has rank k+1 and lies in F_(h-k). All assertions refer to the actual constant connection; no connection is assigned to a Birkhoff complement.

## 3. Height 8 is excluded without strengthening top S

If h=8, C=O(-10). Its actual inclusion in H* O has an equivariant coefficient map Sym10 W->H*. The nine independent directions from Section 2 force its image to have dimension at least 9. By (4), every proper quotient of Sym10 W=A_std+V+D has dimension at most 8. Hence the coefficient map is injective. Its image is a genuine constant space U_11 isomorphic to Sym10 W.

For a complete degree-e polynomial line in Sym^e W O, its kth osculating bundle is

    Sym^k W O(k-e), with fiber l^(e-k) Sym^k W.       (9)

This is the universal differentiation/multiplication identity, not a selected-parameter evaluation. Its generic containment in a saturated F_(h-k) extends everywhere. Thus Sym8 W O(-2) lies in S inside U_11 O.

Under invariant apolarity on Sym10 W, the annihilator of l^2 Sym8 W is l^9 W. The projection of E into U_11* O therefore factors through W O(-9). But every summand of (3) has degree at least -8, so this morphism is zero even without equivariance. Consequently all of U_11 annihilates E and U_11 O lies in S, contradicting H0(S)=0. This argument uses only top S<=-1, not the stronger profile21 bound.

## 4. Height 7 gives a genuine constant splitting

Suppose h=7. Now C=O(-8); its coefficient map Sym8 W->H* has image dimension at least 8. Since Sym8 W=P+D and every proper quotient has dimension at most 5, it is injective. Let U_9 be its actual constant image. Formula (9) puts

    Sym7 W O(-1) inside S and inside U_9 O.

Its annihilator in U_9* O is the complete degree-eight line J_0=O(-8). Thus the actual projection

    p:E -> U_9* O

factors through J_0. For the exact source (3), only its O(-8) summand can map to J_0; all higher-degree summands have zero Hom. The resulting scalar on O(-8) is nonzero. Otherwise U_9 O would be a constant subbundle of S, again impossible.

Put N=ker(H->U_9*), a constant 21-space. Choose an equivariant Birkhoff splitting E=F+J with

    F=D O(-2)+(W'+T)O(-3)+V O(-4),  J=O(-8).        (10)

This splitting is not assumed horizontal. Its actual embedded F lies in N O. The actual inclusion J->H O has a coefficient map Sym8 W->H. Its composition with H->U_9* is an isomorphism on coefficient spaces, because p|J is a nonzero isomorphism onto the complete line J_0. Hence that coefficient map is injective and its image C_9 is a constant complement to N:

    H=N direct-sum C_9,
    E=F direct-sum J as actual embedded bundles.     (11)

This proves the constant splitting rather than selecting a horizontal complement from (10). Equivalently the entire degree-eight graph is removed by a constant linear shear, justified by completeness of its coefficient system. No coefficient is chosen or evaluated.

The inclusion F->N O is saturated: the quotient of (11) is

    H O/E=(N O/F) direct-sum (C_9 O/J),

and it is locally free. Thus both actual summands in the constant decomposition have their own well-defined Gauss derivatives. Those derivatives are block diagonal. The nonconstant line J has Gauss kernel zero and quotient J=O(-8), so cancellation from (1) gives the actual Gauss quotient

    A_F=O(2)+O(16).                                 (12)

Here and below cancellation is of actual direct sums; uniqueness of splitting on P1 gives the written ordinary and equivariant degrees. Rank F=16 and deg F=-46.

## 5. The residual dual endpoint is a forced three-step chain

Set S_F=(N O/F)* and S_J=(C_9 O/J)*. Equation (11) gives the actual constant decomposition

    S=S_F direct-sum S_J,
    rank S_F=5, deg S_F=-46.

The complete degree-eight line J has apolar annihilator

    S_J=Sym7 W O(-1),
    L_J=S_J^-=Sym6 W O(-2).                         (13)

For example, the fibers are l Sym7 W and l^2 Sym6 W; differentiation modulo l Sym7 W proves the second identity, which is a saturated kernel. The quotient B_J=S_J/L_J is O(6). Its rank is one, as is the derivative rank of L_J: the latter is at most one by its induced injection into B_J(-2), and cannot be zero because L_J is negative and saturated.

Let L_F=S_F^-. Block diagonal differentiation gives

    L=L_F direct-sum L_J,  rank L_F=3,
    B=B_F direct-sum O(6), B_F=S_F/L_F.

Cancelling O(6) from the exact zero-defect B in (2) yields

    B_F=O(-4)+O(-18),   deg L_F=-46-(-22)=-24.       (14)

The endpoint condition rank beta_L<=2 and rank beta_(L_J)=1 imply rank beta_(L_F)<=1. It is positive by negativity. Applying the actual kernel construction repeatedly to S_F gives

    M_0=S_F, M_1=L_F, M_2=M_1^-, M_3=M_2^-,
    M_4=0,

with ranks5,3,2,1,0. Indeed all successive derivative ranks are at most one by (5), and positive while the bundle is nonzero.

Each line quotient M_j/M_(j+1), j=1,2,3, injects into B_F(-2j) and hence has degree at most -4-2j. Their sum is deg L_F=-24, precisely

    (-6)+(-8)+(-10)=-24.

Thus equality holds separately. As in (7), the exact composite images are the top lines, and M_3 is the saturated line O(-10). Its first three actual derivatives lie in S_F and give four independent generic directions. We will not infer from this that its coefficient system is complete.

## 6. A partial coefficient quotient and its apolar factor

Let

    q:Sym10 W -> R subset N*

be the actual coefficient map of M_3=O(-10), with R its constant image. It is a quotient onto R, possibly proper. Duality embeds R* into (Sym10 W)*. The actual projection of F to R* O followed by this embedding is a map

    F -> R* O -> (Sym10 W)* O.                       (15)

The four osculating directions of M_3 are images under q of the universal fibers l^7 Sym3 W. They lie in S_F, which is annihilated by F. Therefore (15) annihilates l^7 Sym3 W. The full apolar annihilator of these universal fibers is l^4 Sym6 W, and hence(15) factors through the saturated bundle

    (Sym6 W) O(-4)=(V+P)O(-4).                      (16)

This uses the injection R*->(Sym10 W)*, not a fictitious full rational-normal system inside R. It is valid for every quotient q, irrespective of ramification or the rank of the projected osculating image. Under the fixed self-duality, (16) embeds in (Sym10 W)* O by multiplication by l^4.

By(10), all summands of F except V O(-4) have zero Hom to(16) by degree. The V block has only the scalar channel to the unique V in Sym6 W. This scalar is nonzero: if (15) were zero, the projection F->R* O would be zero, making the nonzero R a constant subspace of S_F. But S_F is a subbundle of S and H0(S)=0.

Consequently the constant subspace R* inside (Sym10 W)* contains l^4 V for every parameter line l. Section 7 proves that these fibers span the whole Sym10 space. Thus R is necessarily full and dim R=11. The rank 13 subbundle

    D O(-2)+(W'+T)O(-3) inside F

is killed by the projection N O->R* O. Its constant kernel has dimension 21-11=10. An injection of a rank 13 bundle into this rank 10 bundle is impossible. This is the desired contradiction.

## 7. The universal sextic-net span, without a coefficient calculation

The copy V in Sym6 W is three-dimensional and consists of independent binary sextics. Its common-zero divisor, if nonempty, is G-invariant on P1 and has degree at most 6. Projectively G acts as A5. Every point stabilizer is cyclic: a finite group fixing a point embeds by its tangent character in C*, because a finite-order transformation with trivial tangent multiplier is the identity. The cyclic subgroups of A5 have order at most 5. Hence every orbit has size at least 60/5=12. A nonempty invariant divisor of degree at most 6 is impossible, so the sextic net V is basepoint-free.

Its evaluation sequence is therefore exact in vector bundles:

    0 -> T_V -> V O -> O(6) -> 0.

Here rank T_V=2 and deg T_V=-6. The coefficient inclusion V->H0(O(6)) is injective, so H0(T_V)=0. Birkhoff splitting writes

    T_V=O(-a)+O(-b),  a,b>=1, a+b=6.

In particular a,b<=5. Twisting by 4 gives H1(T_V(4))=0 because each line degree is at least -1. Hence the global-section map is onto:

    V tensor Sym4 W -> Sym10 W.                    (17)

Pure fourth powers span Sym4 W in characteristic zero. Thus the span of l^4 V over all lines l is exactly the image in (17), which is the full degree-ten space. This is the fact used in Section 6. It holds for any independent basepoint-free sextic net; no special coordinates, matrices or actual coefficients enter its proof.

## 8. Contribution, checks and boundaries

The new exclusion uses both original B possibilities in (2), keeping their different defects and endpoint degrees separate. The difficult zero-defect height 7 branch is resolved by actual constant splitting, a residual rank-one endpoint chain, and dual injection of a possibly partial polynomial quotient into the full apolar space. Completeness is proved only after the universal sextic-net span applies. No non-horizontal bundle projector is substituted for the constant projection.

The bounded verifier authenticates all seven inputs, the exact two historical records, both six-partition capacities and equality optimizers, all rank/degree identities, the relevant universal character identities, Hom-degree vanishings and every possible pair a,b>=1 with a+b=6 in the sextic-net argument. It does not rerun the historical enumeration, prove its geometric coverage, sample a parameter, or evaluate any actual instance. The geometry and saturation arguments are supplied in this proof and are subject to independent whole-proof review.

All other profile11 A shapes remain outside this note. No global COV theorem, generic rank-four lower bound, maximal Gauss rank, obstruction value, full-adjoint invertibility, smoothing, algebraicity or original-theorem repair is claimed.

actual-splitting.content:
# Actual equivariant splitting constraints and Gauss persistence

## Result and scope

The actual equivariant cohomology and kernel presentations imply:

1. E has at most 28 formal equivariant splitting types, explicitly parametrized below. Every ordinary line summand has degree in {-2,-3,-4,-5,-8,-9,-10}; in particular none has degree below -10.
2. H0(E(2)) can vanish in only one of these types:

       E = (W'+2T6) tensor O(-3) + V tensor O(-4).    (1)

3. H0(E(3)) contains W'+2T6, and H0(Q*(3)) contains T6.
4. If the actual SF has generic rank three and its maximal rank-three plateau has k blocks below E and l blocks above it, then

       1<=k<=3,  1<=l<=3.

   Moreover l<=2 unless (1) holds. Thus l=3 forces the unique splitting (1).

The 28 types are compatible formal splitting data, not a realization theorem. No generic-rank-three exclusion follows here. The frozen lower bounds generic SF rank>=3 and positive-square rank>=27 remain unchanged. There is no new conclusion about maximal rank, smoothing, or the generic section count.

The argument uses no actual coefficients, actual matrix/rank tests, or local-model experiments. Its polynomial-jet argument is a universal proof for arbitrary sections, not a selected instance computation.

## 1. Actual input and conventions

Let G be the binary icosahedral group, W the standard center-odd two-space, W' its other two-space, A=Sym^2 W, V the other even three-space, P4 the even four-space, S4=Sym^3 W, D5=Sym^4 W, and T6=Sym^5 W. All these irreducibles are self-dual.

The actual bundles have equivariant presentations

    0 -> E -> M3 tensor O(-1) -> M4 tensor O -> 0,
    0 -> Q* -> M3* tensor O(-1) -> M2* tensor O -> 0,

where

    M2=A+2V+3P4+4D5,
    M3=3W'+3S4+6T6,
    M4=2V+4P4+3D5.

The second sequence is obtained by dualizing the actual locally free quotient presentation of D_lin and twisting by O(-1), since Q=D_lin(1). The uniform injectivity of the first multiplication map ensures this is an exact sequence of bundles. These presentations were established in the frozen positive double-hyperplane and uniform hyperplane notes.

We retain rank E=17, deg E=-54, H0(E(1))=0, and rank Q*=13, deg Q*=-54. E and Q* are center-even. E contains no constant subbundle and spans the constant ambient H; the dual statements hold for Q*. We use chi_G for equivariant Euler characteristic.

The first presentation gives

    H1(E(1)) = W'+3T6,
    chi_G(E(2)) = -V,
    chi_G(E(3)) = W'+2T6.                         (2)

The second gives

    H1(Q*) = M2,
    chi_G(Q*(3)) = T6-2W-S4.                     (3)

All identities are checked by exact abstract character arithmetic in the verifier. In particular the positive irreducible multiplicities in (2)-(3) imply

    H0(E(3)) contains W'+2T6,
    H0(Q*(3)) contains T6.                        (4)

Indeed the multiplicity of any irreducible in H0 equals its Euler multiplicity plus its nonnegative multiplicity in H1. No vanishing of the corresponding H1 is presumed.

## 2. Equivariant splitting is legitimate

For a finite group in characteristic zero, Birkhoff-Grothendieck splitting may be chosen equivariantly. One proof uses the canonical slope filtration, which is G-invariant. Its graded pieces of equal degree are R_j tensor O(-j). The extensions between successive distinct slopes split: Ext^1(O(b),O(a))=H1(O(a-b))=0 for a>b. Averaging any splitting over G makes it equivariant without changing its right-inverse property.

This equivariant splitting need not be canonical or compatible with the ambient connection. It is used only for bundle cohomology, not as a horizontal splitting of any Gauss flag.

Thus write

    E = direct sum_(j>=2) R_j tensor O(-j).         (5)

The lower bound j>=2 follows from H0(E(1))=0. The multiplicity spaces R_j are genuine representations. Since E is center-even, the central involution acts on R_j by (-1)^j. The standard linearization of O(-j) has exactly this sign; there is no additional character because G is perfect.

By equivariant Serre duality, using det W=1 and self-duality of Sym^n W,

    H1(E(1)) = sum_(j>=3) R_j tensor Sym^(j-3) W.   (6)

All terms on the right are genuine representations, so forbidden irreducible constituents cannot cancel.

## 3. Complete list of possible negative blocks

The right side of (6) is W'+3T6 and has dimension 20. For every nonzero irreducible summand R in R_j,

    (j-2) dim R <=20.

In particular j<=22. Checking the nine irreducible representations with their required central parity over this finite range gives exactly the following possibilities:

| j | R | Contribution R tensor Sym^(j-3) W |
|---:|---|---|
| 3 | W' | W' |
| 3 | T6 | T6 |
| 4 | V | T6 |
| 4 | P4 | W'+T6 |
| 5 | W' | T6 |
| 8 | 1 | T6 |
| 9 | W | W'+2T6 |
| 10 | 1 | W'+T6 |

Every other parity-compatible irreducible either contributes W or S4, another forbidden constituent, or exceeds an available multiplicity. This is a complete finite representation check, not a choice of a map or coefficient.

Let a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h be the multiplicities of these eight rows in order. Equation (6) becomes

    a+d+g+h = 1,
    b+c+d+e+f+2g+h = 3.                           (7)

At twist two the same blocks give

    H1(E(2)) = (c+g+h)V
               +(d+e+g+h)P4 +(f+g)D5.

Meanwhile H0(E(2))=R_2. The actual identity chi_G(E(2))=-V therefore forces

    R_2 = (c+g+h-1)V
          +(d+e+g+h)P4 +(f+g)D5.                 (8)

This is genuine precisely when

    c+g+h >=1.                                    (9)

There are exactly 28 nonnegative integer solutions of (7)-(9): ten with a=1, four with d=1, four with g=1, and ten with h=1. Each has total rank 17 and degree -54. Equations (7)-(8), together with the table, completely specify all 28 formal equivariant splitting types compatible with these cohomological constraints.

The coefficients in (8) vanish simultaneously only for

    (a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h)=(1,2,1,0,0,0,0,0).

This is exactly (1). Every other candidate has H0(E(2)) nonzero. Its possible dimension is one of 3,4,...,14; the exceptional candidate has dimension zero.

This classification does not assert that each type occurs for the actual multiplication pencil or can be embedded with the required Gauss rank. It gives necessary actual bundle data only.

## 4. A section bounds the length of a constant-rank Gauss plateau

The following lemma applies to any generic rank r, not only three.

Let

    F0 subset F1 subset ... subset Fm,
    Fk=E,   m=k+l,

be a maximal consecutive plateau of rank-r Gauss blocks. At each interior stage, the derivative kernel and forward transform satisfy

    ker beta_(Fi)=F_(i-1),    Fi^+=F_(i+1).        (10)

The inclusions come from differentiation; equal generic ranks and saturation give equality of sheaves. Exactly as in the frozen rank-two argument, every Fi with i<m contains no nonzero constant subbundle: above E any constant subbundle propagates backwards through the kernels in (10). Every Fi with i>0 spans the whole ambient constant space: below E a proper constant span would propagate forward to E. These arguments are independent of the value of r.

Suppose H0(E(d)) is nonzero. Saturate the image of a nonzero map O(-d)->E to a line L=O(-e). Then e<=d. The line is also saturated in the constant ambient bundle, because both successive quotients are locally free. Moreover e>=1: a nonnegative-degree line in a trivial bundle must have degree zero and be constant, contradicting H0(E)=0.

The inclusion O(-e)->H tensor O is represented on an affine coordinate chart by a polynomial vector

    f(z)=v0+v1 z+...+ve z^e.

The vectors f(z), f'(z),...,f^(e)(z) span the constant coefficient space <v0,...,ve>: the change of generators is triangular with nonzero factorial diagonal in characteristic zero. Therefore the e-th forward Gauss transform of L has reached its constant span, possibly earlier. Saturating extends this equality across the omitted parameter and across derivative ramification.

Inductively the j-th transform of L is contained in F_(k+j), whenever that stage exists, because differentiation and saturation preserve the inclusion. If l>d, its constant span would be contained in the interior stage F_(k+e), since e<=d<l. This contradicts (10) and its constant-subbundle consequence. Hence

    H0(E(d)) nonzero  implies  l<=d.               (11)

Apply the same argument to the dual reversed plateau, whose central bundle is E^perp=Q*. Its forward length is k, so

    H0(Q*(d)) nonzero  implies  k<=d.              (12)

This proof does not split the plateau into line curves. It uses just one saturated line supplied by a section, inside the original filtered bundle.

## 5. Consequence for a hypothetical rank-three SF

For generic SF rank three, monotonicity of outward Gauss increments gives a maximal rank-three plateau. A priori 1<=k<=5 and 1<=l<=4, since rank E=17 and codimension E=13. Its endpoints have SF rank one or two; no rank-one endpoint theorem is assumed for them.

Equations (4), (11), and (12) sharpen the bounds to

    1<=k<=3,   1<=l<=3.

For each of the 27 nonexceptional splitting types, H0(E(2)) is nonzero, so l<=2. If l=3, the actual splitting is necessarily (1). This is the promised bounded rank-three constraint, not a contradiction.

## Reproduction

Run `python verify_equivariant_splitting_gauss_persistence.py`.

The verifier checks the actual Euler characters, the complete finite list of allowed irreducible splitting blocks, all 28 coefficient tuples, their rank/degree and cohomology identities, and the unique twist-two-section-free type. The universal jet/saturation proof is supplied above; no actual polynomial vector or HM map is evaluated.

four-sources.content:
# The primary terminal space lies in the canonical degree-minus-three slope piece

Work over C with the actual normalized HM module and fixed physical G=SL2(F5) marking. Write V and W for the positive three-space and negative two-space of coordinates, A=Sym2 W, P for the positive four-space, W' for the other negative doublet, and T6=Sym5 W. Let E be the actual rank17, degree−54 kernel on the fixed negative parameter line T=P(W*) in

    0 -> E -> M3 O(-1) -> M4 O -> 0,
    M4=H1(B(4))_+, M5=H1(B(5))_-.

## 1. Immutable assumptions and result

The complete originals used are:

- PR477 at ff87076794e97238150485b12183c3cd0f4711e4, research/hm/adjoint-primary-extension/PROOF.md: the actual injective graded polynomial-module map L_j=U tensor H1(F(j-3)) into K_j=H1(B(j-1)).
- PR486 at 0de9b4b71cbbf3c4492871d9835952a0dcb41e12, research/hm/level-section-resolution/PROOF.md: Soc(K)=K6.
- PR1120 at 62587a0adde566cac718ee13c28ee13c239389e5, research/hm/scalar-cyclic-module/PROOF.md: U=P, H1(F(2))=1+A+T6, H1(F(3))=W, with their actual physical parity, and P tensor W=W'+T6.
- PR1122 at 65c13bb9a3748a19eb8466f748bd29a5a849ecb5, research/hm/primary-terminal-source2-exclusion/PROOF.md: the independently reviewed preceding slice establishes the actual primary terminal evaluation pencil and its obstruction against the genuine source2 first block. Section2 below reconstructs its primary lemma from the same original maps, while the new argument replaces a source-specific projector by the canonical slope quotient.
- PR1056 at 875e86e2eec36a050e9a626735199681762e43ec, research/hm/restriction-socle-kernel/PROOF.md: the actual E above, H0(E(1))=0, natural identifications M4=H1(E), M5=H1(E(1)), and actual negative multiplication identified with parameter multiplication after one fixed determinant rotation. These are unconditional on the necessary source-pair ledger. Its Section5 describes E10,E13,E14 only conditionally.
- ACTUAL at db51525015bb7c5e825833d550d08dedf6f6ea96, research/hm/order-four-quadratic-load/ACTUAL-EQUIVARIANT-SPLITTING-AND-GAUSS-PERSISTENCE.md: an equivariant Birkhoff splitting E=direct sum R_j O(-j), j>=2, the genuine coefficient representations R_j, and the complete 28-type equations recalled below. # Negative Gauss kernels strictly lower the highest splitting degree

## Lemma

Let F be a saturated subbundle of a constant bundle H tensor O on P1 over C. Suppose every ordinary splitting degree of F is at most -d, where d>0. Let Fminus be the kernel of its second fundamental form for the constant connection. Then

    H0(Fminus(d))=0,

so every splitting degree of Fminus is at most -d-1. A zero kernel is allowed. No constant-rank plateau or equivariance hypothesis is needed.

**Proof.** If a nonzero section of Fminus(d) existed, regard it in H0(F(d)). Every summand of F(d) has nonpositive degree, so this section is a nonzero constant vector in the degree-zero summand. It gives a nowhere-vanishing direct bundle summand C=O(-d) of F. In particular F/C is locally free, and C is saturated in H O because both F/C and H O/F are locally free.

Since the second fundamental form of F kills C, the second fundamental form of C takes values in (F/C) tensor Omega1, not just in the whole ambient quotient. All degrees of (F/C) tensor Omega1 are at most -d-2. Thus

    Hom(O(-d),(F/C) tensor Omega1)=0.

C is therefore horizontal in the constant ambient bundle. Its Grassmannian classifying map has zero differential and is constant in characteristic zero. Saturation then makes C a constant line subbundle, of degree zero, contradicting d>0. This proves the lemma. No splitting of the connection has been assumed.

## Iteration and the actual new constraint

Every successive Gauss kernel is saturated in the same constant ambient bundle. Indeed the derivative kernel is saturated in its source, and its quotient and the earlier ambient quotient are locally free. Iterating the lemma gives

    max degree(F^(-r)) <= -d-r

for every existing backward transform, without assuming that later ranks equal any prescribed plateau rank.

In the actual proof-repair setup, E is saturated in the constant thirty-space and the independently proved GLOBAL input is H0(E(1))=0. Hence its degrees are at most -2. Consequently

    H0(E^-(2))=0,
    H0(E^{--}(3))=0,
    H0(E^{---}(4))=0,

and, generally, H0(E^(-r)(r+1))=0. These constraints apply even when the maximal forward length is one. They are stronger than using only the endpoint-length persistence bound in those branches.

This is a new application to the remaining Gauss profiles, not a claim that the second-fundamental-form argument is historically new. It neither excludes every remaining profile nor proves SF>=4. The remaining profile list and generic positive-square bound are unchanged until the new constraints are applied completely.

For example, write K=E^- and A0=E/K. The actual derivative K -> A0(-2) has kernel E^{--}. The new H0(E^{--}(3))=0 therefore gives the ONE-step representation bound

    H0(K(3)) injects into H0(A0(1)),
    chi_G(K(3)) <= H0(A0(1)).

No extra H0(A0(-1)) term is needed for this bound. The second inequality follows because H1(K(3)) is genuine. This statement is valid for the actual E with its global degree input, not for an unrelated bundle lacking that input.

## Equivariant multiplicity bottleneck

More generally suppose C=R tensor O(-d) is a nonzero direct summand of F at its highest degree, and the derivative of F kills C. The same proof, now for a higher-rank constant-coefficient summand, makes C horizontal and contradicts its negative degree. Thus no nonzero constant multiplicity subspace of the top splitting block can be annihilated identically.

If a derivative of F is known to land in a bundle T, the induced map

    H0(F(d)) -> H0(T(d))

must be injective. With a finite group action this is an injective map of representations, so each source multiplicity is bounded by the corresponding target multiplicity. It is NOT fiberwise injectivity of F -> T: a polynomial map may be injective on global sections while having a lower generic fiber rank.

A useful special case is F=C O(-d)+N with every degree of N at most -d and beta_F(C O(-d))=0. Its internal second fundamental form takes values in N(-2), so that top summand is already horizontal. No long descent through all lower summands is required. The saturated-image convention remains essential.

## Sources and reproduction

The actual inclusion, global H0(E(1)) input and ordinary splitting are in ACTUAL-EQUIVARIANT-SPLITTING-AND-GAUSS-PERSISTENCE.md and POSITIVE-DOUBLE-HYPERPLANE-GAUSS-GATE.md. The recursive saturated-kernel principle is Section1 of EXTREMAL-31-FIRST-REMAINING-QUOTIENT-EXCLUSION.md. This proof strengthens the available backward degree input without changing those files.

Run python3 verify_negative_gauss_strict_top_slope.py. It checks the universal degree inequalities, iteration and the resulting actual three vanishings, and the twist of the one-step target. The saturated-line and characteristic-zero argument above is the mathematical proof; the elementary arithmetic is not a substitute for it. No actual coefficient, point, instance matrix, rank experiment or scan is used.
